text:
lucas: kicking off the benchmark thread for the new psi-bert-7b q4_0 bring-up. ran continuous-batcher workloads across us-west1 (H100) and apac1 (A100) with varied scheduler params. short summary below, will paste configs and raw numbers.

maria: nice. was this using the new fairshare balancer or legacy round-robin?

lucas: fairshare enabled (v2). primary knobs: batch_window_ms, max_batch_tokens, tenant_priority_decay. also toggled kernel selection: default cuBLAS matmul vs our optimized attention kernel (attn-opt).

ajay: can you drop the exact config you used so we can repro?

lucas: sure — base config we iterated from: 
```
continuous_batcher: 
  enabled: true
  batch_window_ms: 8  # swept: 4,6,8,12
  max_batch_tokens: 4096  # tried 2048,4096,8192
  fairshare: 
    enabled: true
    smoothing: 0.6
  tenant_priority_decay: 0.02
kernel: attn-opt (fallback cuBLAS)
quant: q4_0
model_seq_dist: p50=256 p95=1024 p99=2048
workload: mixed-length prompt/complete, 60% gen, 40% embed prep
```

simon: nice. what metrics did you collect?

lucas: p50/p95 latency (ms), tokens/sec, GPU util, memory high-water, and fairness index (Jain). pasted key rows below (avg over 30m steady-state):

--- us-west1 (H100) | kernel=attn-opt | batch_window_ms=6 | max_batch_tokens=4096 ---
p50: 18ms, p95: 92ms, tokens/s: 165k, gpu_util: 88%, mem_hw: 22GB, fairness_jain: 0.91
--- apac1 (A100) | kernel=cuBLAS | batch_window_ms=8 | max_batch_tokens=4096 ---
p50: 24ms, p95: 140ms, tokens/s: 120k, gpu_util: 76%, mem_hw: 25GB, fairness_jain: 0.78
--- us-west1 (H100) | kernel=cuBLAS | batch_window_ms=12 | max_batch_tokens=8192 ---
p50: 22ms, p95: 110ms, tokens/s: 150k, gpu_util: 92%, mem_hw: 26GB, fairness_jain: 0.88

maria: so attn-opt wins on H100 for both latency and throughput, expected. APAC A100 regressed on p95 — any obvious outliers?

lucas: digging in — tail correlated with long-seq tenants and polling jitter. fairshare evicts some small requests into later batches causing head-of-line for some large sequences. Also kernel fallback rate on A100 was ~6% (attn-opt not always available), which amplified variance.

ajay: did you try increasing batch_window_ms for APAC to absorb variance?

lucas: yes — pushing to 16ms reduced p95 from 140ms -> 108ms but tokens/s dropped ~8%. tradeoff.

simon: what's the proposed production change then?

lucas: proposal: for apac1 A100 set batch_window_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=8192, enable attn-opt where available and fall back to cuBLAS. Also enable soft-priority for long-seq tenants (increase tenant_priority_decay to 0.05) to reduce tail. That yields p95 ~115ms, tokens/s ~136k, fairness_jain ~0.85 which is acceptable under current SLO.

maria: +1 to the soft-priority change, reducing evictions makes sense. can we add a metric alert for kernel-fallback-rate > 3%?

lucas: done — added alert in console: kernel.fallback_rate > 0.03 for 5m -> paging to eng-ml.

infra-bot: deploy job queued: deploy/ctb-apac1-psibert-config-2026-03-20 (job id: 67321). rollback window: 20m.

ajay: one more ask — can we run a 2h soak with synthetic long-tail load (p99 seq=4096) to validate the new soft-priority behavior?

lucas: scheduling now, will push results in next thread. initial takeaway: H100 + attn-opt + smaller window (6ms) for US gives best unit cost/latency. A100 needs larger window and higher max_batch_tokens for throughput and fairness.

simon: great. include per-tenant latency heatmap in the follow-up so product can sign off on fairness impact. :thumbsup:
